items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: Alma Turner kept us at the Gram Terrace.

ctx.x: You only played one night at the Grand Terrace? You didn't even play one night?

Wait a minute, we were rehearsing and the man said, "You're through." And Alma Turner says, "What's wrong with you? What do you expect of these people? Why don't you go around and get the Chicago Symphony to play this music?" Alma Turner kept us at the Gram Terrace.
Oh then you did play there?
